decisions.reason: It survived the firm's early post-launch pruning, fits closely with its dental workflow materials business, and a large established firm with some slack would usually keep such a product unless results clearly fell below aspiration.

As a core thermoforming material aligned with the firm's precision manufacturing and dental channels, it likely reached a satisfactory aspiration level and does not create enough pressure to trigger problemistic search away from it.

This accessory product appears less central and was promoted more lightly, so its aspiration match is somewhat more uncertain, but the firm's size and complementary portfolio still make retention more likely than exit.

Although the firm already culled another earmold-related launch, this hearing-protection line still matches its custom manufacturing capabilities and hearing-care customer base, so management would more likely continue it while monitoring whether it stays above aspiration.
